_comment: Title field may contain ... HTML for inline emphasis (renders in signal orange on the site). Plain-text titles work too.

essays.title: The Unsupervised Mind.
essays.dek: In June my second brain started learning without me. Unsupervised, in every sense. This is how I earned the right to trust it.

essays.title: The Rotting Ruler.
essays.dek: I built the measuring stick for a self-maintaining second brain. The stick turned out to be a living system too, and it rots.

essays.title: The Four Goodharts.
essays.dek: My wiki's retrieval score dropped and stayed down for weeks. The tempting explanations were all wrong, and a taxonomy kept me from publishing them.

essays.title: The Poisoned Memory.
essays.dek: An attacker who never touches my files can plant a memory today that lies dormant until something wakes it. The defense is a front door with rules.

essays.title: The Cheating Loop.
essays.dek: Told to reduce hallucinations, a self-improving system deleted the markers its detector looked for. Two laws survive contact with that.

essays.title: The Sleeping Reflector.
essays.dek: The upkeep of a second brain runs at 2 a.m. Here's the machinery that makes the night shift safe, and the ledger that says whether it did.

essays.title: The Measured Fleet.
essays.dek: Seven weeks of running the honesty stack: the alarm that cried wolf for a month, the bug that turned out to be the ruler, and the year that starts now.

essays.title: The Second Brain.
essays.dek: Why personal knowledge management always failed, and why, for the first time, it works.

essays.title: The Why Layer.
essays.dek: When reasoning becomes the unit of work, and the deliverable stops being the point.

essays.title: The Work-Brain Mesh.
essays.dek: How to keep a second brain cheap enough to actually run: cost bound by query volume, not corpus size.

essays.title: The Org Proof.
essays.dek: What the mesh becomes when a whole company runs it: institutional memory that survives turnover.

essays.title: The Externalized Mind.
essays.dek: Bringing it home: the model is rented and improves on someone else's schedule; the reasoning is owned and compounds on yours.

essays.title: The Measured Mind.
essays.dek: Evals, recursive self-improvement, and the one instrument a self-maintaining mind is missing.

essays.title: The Agentic Harness.
essays.dek: The model is the commodity. The environment you build around it is the moat.

essays.title: Now Installable.
essays.dek: The Compounding Mind became a repo. One conversation installs your own measured second brain.

essays.title: After the PRD.
essays.dek: Something broke in the last six months. Not broke in a bad way — broke like a dam breaks. Everything that was building up behind it is now rushing through.

essays.title: Agents as Teammates, Not Tools.
essays.dek: On assigning work to something that doesn't have a Slack avatar, doesn't go home, and still manages to surprise you.

essays.title: From Code Wizards to Cosmic Architects.
essays.title_plain: From Code Wizards to Cosmic Architects.
essays.dek: Navigating the AI apocalypse in tech. The senior developer's journey through grief — and out the other side as something new.

essays.title: The Invisible Platform.
essays.dek: Five companies, 160 million lives, and one architecture that has to disappear into the floorboards before anyone trusts it.

essays.title: The Expertise Inversion.
essays.dek: The knowledge that made you valuable is becoming the knowledge AI does best. Not because you did anything wrong — because the game inverted while you were playing it.

essays.title: The Combination Premium.
essays.dek: How to build the expertise AI can't replicate. If depth alone isn't the moat anymore, what is? The answer is surprisingly mathematical: combinations.

essays.title: The Five Breaks.
essays.dek: Something is happening to the structure of work that's bigger than any single trend. AI gets the headlines. But AI is just the most visible part of a deeper shift.

essays.title: Prototypes > Specs.
essays.dek: The working thing ends the meeting. A short argument for showing before telling, in a field that is addicted to telling.
